queryName: IAM Role OIDC Trust Unrestricted Sub Condition
descriptionText: An AWS IAM role that trusts an OIDC provider via 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' must restrict the 'sub' (subject) claim to an allow-list. If no condition restricts 'sub' to specific values (negated operators like 'StringNotEquals' and non-string operators like 'Null' do not count), or it uses an overly permissive pattern (e.g. 'StringLike' with '*' or 'repo:*'), any identity able to obtain a token from the OIDC provider may assume the role.
